Distinct members marked present: Members marked present at least once
Association/member counts and project st: Association and member counts and project statuses show their current state. They do not show what the numbers or statuses were in the past.
Archived records are retained within the: Archived records are included within the association you can access. Counts reflect only the information recorded in the system.
Program year is an administrative cohort: Program year groups projects by their recorded program year. Reporting year and quarter select training start dates, activity dates, and monitoring periods.
No achievement, completion-rate, profit: This report does not calculate achievement, completion rates, profit, or an official count of trained members.
Gross income is reported in PHP (Philipp: Gross income is shown in Philippine pesos (PHP), as approved by the project owner. It is the recorded amount before expenses and is not profit or net income.
A member can have multiple classificatio: A member may belong to more than one group. Do not add the group counts to find the total number of members.
Project portfolio ignores reporting year: The project list does not change with the reporting year or quarter. Use Program year to select projects by their recorded program year.
Recorded participants include absent row: Attendance entries include people marked absent and trainings with any selected status. Present attendance is shown separately. Neither count is an official total of trained members.
Historical participation of archived mem: Past attendance of archived members and archived trainings is included. Date filters use each training's start date.
Only recorded gross-income entries are s: Only saved gross income entries are added. A missing entry is not treated as zero. If some months have no entries, the sum may not cover the full quarter.
A monitoring record is a quarterly conta: A quarterly monitoring record is not the same as a site visit. Visit reports include older imported records, so their count is not a verified total of physical visits.
Period filters select the parent monitor: Year and quarter filters select monitoring records for those periods. All visit reports linked to the selected monitoring records are included.
No applicants, names, contact details, b: This report does not include applicants or personal details such as names, contact details, birth dates, registration numbers, or private documents.
Each row is one product observation in o: Each row shows one product entry for a quarter. Amounts with different units or from different quarters are not added together.
Monthly quantities and their saved quart: Monthly amounts and the saved quarterly actual output may describe the same production, so they are not added together. Older quarterly values are kept, and missing months are not estimated.
Missing rows are unobserved, not zero. A: A missing entry does not mean zero. If you select a product, the coverage comparison includes only that product.
Recorded indicators within the applied s: These figures cover the selected report and filters. A missing record does not mean zero.
Recorded values within the applied scope: These values cover the selected report and filters. A missing record does not mean zero.
Production observation coverage: Recorded production entries by period and unit
One recorded current status per associat: Each association has one current status. Whether it is archived is recorded separately.
Totals include retained archived members: Totals include archived members whose records are kept. These are current counts and do not show past growth.
A member may appear in several classific: A member may appear in several groups. Do not add the group counts to find the number of members.
One current status per selected project,: Each selected project has one current status, including archived projects whose records are kept. Status alone does not show whether a project succeeded.
Counts describe the selected portfolio a: Counts describe the selected projects and program years. They do not show a trend of events over time.
Counts use selected training start dates: Counts use the selected training start dates. The number of activities does not measure how effective the training was.
Counts of product-quarter observations b: Counts show product entries for each quarter and recorded unit. They do not show the amount produced.
Saved gross-income entries by quarter an: Saved gross income is grouped by quarter and by whether it was recorded monthly or quarterly. Gross income is not profit. Missing monthly entries mean the sum may not cover the whole quarter.
Recorded activity counts, not livelihood: These are counts of recorded activities, not measures of livelihood outcomes. Program-wide activities follow your permitted report access.
Historically saved status on quarterly c: These are the statuses saved in quarterly monitoring records. Monitoring records and older imported reports do not confirm the number of physical visits.
This report covers only your currently active linked association.
Monthly trend unavailable for this selec: A monthly trend cannot be shown with the current filters. Choose Production Performance, then select one project and one product with a consistent unit and at least two months of recorded data. Missing or unclear data remains available in the detailed tables.
Present and absent participation rows ar: Present and absent entries are shown separately. No attendance entries means none were recorded; it does not prove nobody attended. A person may attend more than once, so these entries are not a count of different people or an official trained-member total.
Each pair is one product-quarter observa: Each pair shows one product's recorded target and actual output for a quarter. Units and quarters remain separate. Missing output is not treated as zero. Monthly details and the quarterly actual may describe the same production, so they are not added. Selecting a month does not make the quarterly output a monthly total.
Counts use geographic IDs and retained a: Counts use the recorded geographic identifiers and include accessible archived associations. A municipality's subtotal is repeated for its barangays, so do not add the subtotal column.
Ranked by distinct authorized associatio: Municipalities are ranked by the number of associations included in this report, including archived associations. A higher count does not show whether a program was successful or effective.
Month filters apply only to these record: The month filter applies to the recorded monthly details. The quarterly table still shows quarterly information. Missing monthly values are not estimated.
Unlinked program activities are availabl: Activities that are not linked to an association are available only to system administrators when no association or municipality filter is applied.
Showing the first 8 recorded units. Deta: Charts show the first eight recorded units. The detailed tables include all units.
